title: 费奥雷半剑式
author: Kingdom Come Combat
first_page: 输入：上、左、右。上段、左斩后，以右斩收尾，双手半剑刺向对手胸口。
second_page: 半剑式不是为了漂亮，而是为了穿过盔甲。握住剑身时要让剑尖像凿子一样稳定。翻到这里，你已经开始练习费奥雷半剑式。

en_us.title: Fiore Halbschwerten
en_us.first_page: Input: Up, Left, Right. After an overhead and left cut, finish from the right by taking the blade in both hands and thrusting into the chest.
en_us.second_page: Half-swording is meant to defeat armor, not to look elegant. Grip the blade and keep the point steady as a chisel.
